scope: Four fixed standard allocation baseline diagnostics; not a candidate method or a performance parameter search. Synthetic controlled DC ports only.
information: Same measured PCC complex voltage before sample queue promotion, same nominal800kW/700kvar requests, same states and100us control clock. No future event/clearance information is used in allocation.

allocation_equations.radial: s=min(1,Icap/sqrt(a0^2+b0^2)); a=s*a0; b=s*b0; use s=1 if a0=b0=0.
allocation_equations.existing_q_priority: b=clip(b0,±Icap); a=clip(a0,±sqrt(max(0,Icap^2-b^2))). Existing Q-priority slow/fast data retained as comparators.

unchanged: All ratings, capacitance, losses, efficiencies, inner PI and antiwindup, PLL, DC feedback and source bounds, initial plant/controller/queue state, normalized-modulation delay, clocks and service requests. Allocation order/radial rule is the sole control difference; port tau/ramp is a separately declared sensitivity.

numerics.event_location: Exact root location for actualI1/1.1pu and DC/SoC bounds; exact event and sample splits.
numerics.refinement: Any indispensable same-condition numerical refinement must be identified as such; no new physical case/gain/threshold is permitted.

scoring: Keep distinct actual-current violation, DC contact, full physical completion, electrical recovery, absolute P and Q service error integrals, signed supply integrals and battery inventory. No physical-safe result is joint-service success merely because Q is sacrificed. First bad contact/violation and all unobserved recovery remain explicit.
negative_control: The slow port .4pu/150ms is excluded by the existing control-independent energy certificate assuming actualI<=1. Any alleged full hard-safe passage requires checking model, sampling, state, constraints and metrics before interpretation.
storage: Same100us full state/control/interval-extrema and dense initial/fault/recovery-boundary recording as the source-speed diagnostic. Original comparison data unchanged.
